name: astra-db
description: Unofficial Astra DB integration by JEStats: query, vector search, guarded writes, and views.
long_description: Unofficial, community-maintained integration by JEStats; not affiliated with or endorsed by DataStax or IBM. Connects Claude to Astra DB (DataStax / IBM). Explore keyspaces, collections, and tables; read with filters; run vector and hybrid search; insert, update, and create schema — destructive operations always ask first. Results render as interactive views, and code_examples returns idiomatic client code for Python, TypeScript, Java, C#, and Go. Reuse an Astra CLI profile or global login, or supply a token in this form to store it in the OS keychain.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Check which credentials and database are in use, with a live connectivity check.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List the Astra databases the token can access.

tools.name: database_overview
tools.description: Map keyspaces, collections, and tables (interactive view).

tools.name: describe_collection
tools.description: Show a collection's vector, vectorize, lexical, rerank, and indexing configuration.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Show a table's columns, primary key, indexes, and vector columns.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Read documents or rows with filters, sorting, and paging (interactive explorer).

tools.name: vector_search
tools.description: Similarity search by text, vector, or document; optional hybrid reranking.

tools.name: list_vectorize_providers
tools.description: Embedding and reranking providers available to the database.

tools.name: code_examples
tools.description: Canonical Data API client code in five languages.

tools.name: update
tools.description: Update documents or rows (bulk updates need confirmation).

tools.name: delete
tools.description: Delete documents or rows (bulk deletes need confirmation).

tools.name: create_collection
tools.description: Create a vector, vectorize, or hybrid-ready collection.

tools.name: create_table
tools.description: Create a typed table with a primary key.

tools.name: create_index
tools.description: Create a regular, vector, or text index on a table column.

tools.name: drop
tools.description: Drop a collection, table, or index (always confirmed).

prompts.name: overview
prompts.text: Call database_overview and summarize the database.

prompts.name: setup
prompts.description: Check the connection and fix it.
prompts.text: Call connection_status and walk me through fixing the connection if needed.

token.title: Astra application token
token.description: Optional: leave empty to reuse an Astra CLI profile or login --global. A token supplied here is stored in your OS keychain. Never paste tokens into chat.

endpoint.title: Data API endpoint
endpoint.description: Optional: https://…apps.astra.datastax.com. Leave empty if the token sees one database.
